space.logical_coord: indirection texel (x within clipmap, y, z) decoded from Texture3D index (x + c*resolution)
space.probe_world_offset_cm: ProbeWorldOffset[physical_id].xyz (stored PF_FloatRGBA/float16x4 when BytesPerElement=8, or PF_A32B32G32R32F when 16; read as float4 by the shader)
space.world_cell: floor((corner - PreViewTranslation) / cell_size + logical_coord + 0.5); integer world cell at this clipmap level, stable under clipmap-origin motion
space.note: ProbeWorldOffset is in translated-world space; it is not a world-space absolute position

indirection_encoding.used_marker: 0xFFFFFFFE is the mark-only marker and must not appear in a completed AllocateUsedProbes output

selection.method: camera invocation first; MarkRadianceProbes(ScreenProbes) parameters matched to AllocateUsedProbes parameters; resource versions taken from that pass's OutputResources

rejected_translucency_volume.reason: translucency-volume variant: 24^3 x3 clipmaps, 8x8 FilterProbeRadiance, no ScreenProbeGather lineage; rejected by MarkRadianceProbes(ScreenProbes) parameter identity and extent

old_global_lowest_producer_probe.reason: counter-example only: global lowest producer id ignores the selected renderer invocation
